description: Read this file before creating or modifying UI components in the project.

# UI Standards

Strictly use shadcn UI components for all UI work in this project. Do not use any other UI logic, custom UI components, or custom UI wrappers when adding or modifying any UI feature.

## Required Rules
- Strictly use shadcn UI components for all interface elements.
- Do not create custom components, custom wrappers, or ad-hoc UI implementations when a shadcn equivalent is available.
- Prefer existing shadcn patterns and primitives before introducing anything new.
- Keep styling consistent with the current Tailwind-based setup.
- When adding or modifying any UI feature, use shadcn UI only and avoid custom UI logic.
